about: Round-11 labels for the NO-OUTFIT outputs only (ids from tests/bench/studio-portraits.json): none = studio.html no-outfit render after the clean-up (studio-core.js cleanLeftovers, matte-failure fallback); pbNone = photobooth.html no-outfit 1-inch ID photo after the clean-up and the small bottom fill (idExtendDraw). 1 = visible defect, 0 = clean. Outfit renders did not change in round 11; their labels stay in studio-labels-r10.json.
labeller: NOT independent: renders whose pixels did not change versus round 10 (more than 0.2 % of pixels differing by > 40 grey levels) keep the round-10 second-rater label; the changed renders (studio: d05, t07; photo booth: d12, d16, d18, d19, t07, t09, t14, t15, t22, t26, t33, t35) were judged by the AI coding agent that wrote the round-11 change, side by side with the round-10 render, not blind. t07 (matte failure) now shows the unchanged original photo and is still counted as defective. No human raters.
criteria: neck/jaw join: hole, notch or step, straight cut line beside the jaw or under the ear, sliver or blob along the jaw, flat or wrong-coloured pasted neck, background gap between hair and neck
garment geometry clearly wrong at normal viewing: balloon/sack body, shoulder raised over the hair, sleeves crossing as tubes, hands pasted or spotted
leftovers: fragments of the original clothes, jewellery or background (flag, chair) left on or beside the person; missing parts or holes from the matte
NOT counted: the procedural/CG look of the garment itself, soft hair edges, small colour differences
